name: SmartBear MCP Server
description: Connects coding agents to SmartBear's BugSnag, Swagger, PactFlow, Zephyr, QMetry, Reflect, and BearQ to debug errors, manage API specs, and run test management.

skills.name: BugSnag Error Debugging
skills.description: Lists project errors, reads events with stack traces and device context, and updates error status or severity.

skills.name: Swagger Studio API Management
skills.description: Searches, fetches, creates, and updates OpenAPI or AsyncAPI definitions and scans them against org standards.

skills.name: PactFlow Contract Testing
skills.description: Generates and reviews Pact tests, fetches provider states, and checks can-i-deploy against the Pact Broker matrix.

skills.name: Zephyr Test Case Management
skills.description: Reads, creates, and updates Zephyr test cases, test scripts, and links to Jira issues and test cycles.
